litigation.type: Federal MDL + nationwide class settlement (state court)
litigation.mdlName: In re: Roundup Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, Northern District of California

phase: Class settlement final approval pending; Supreme Court preemption ruling issued
phaseDetail: A proposed $7.25 billion nationwide class settlement in King v. Monsanto received preliminary approval in Missouri's 22nd Judicial Circuit on March 4, 2026. The official settlement website says the fairness hearing was rescheduled from July 9 to August 19, 2026, and that final approval has not been granted. Separately, the U.S. Supreme Court decided Monsanto Co. v. Durnell (No. 24-1068) on June 25, 2026, holding that FIFRA expressly preempted the state-law label-based failure-to-warn claim at issue.
updateNote: Updated the Durnell preemption result and the rescheduled August 19 settlement fairness hearing from primary sources.

pendingCounts.scope: Reported state-court cases outside the MDL (approximate)

settlements.label: Nationwide class settlement (King v. Monsanto)
settlements.detail: The proposed settlement would provide up to $7.25 billion over roughly 21 years. It received preliminary approval on March 4, 2026. The official settlement website says the fairness hearing was rescheduled to August 19, 2026, and final approval has not been granted.
settlements.source: Official King v. Monsanto settlement website

settlements.label: Prior Bayer settlement programs (2020-2021)
settlements.detail: Bayer previously committed roughly $11 billion (industry-reported) to resolve approximately 100,000 earlier Roundup claims through firm-by-firm settlements. Those programs are separate from the pending 2026 class settlement.

keyDates.label: MDL-2741 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal Roundup cases before Judge Vince Chhabria in the Northern District of California.

keyDates.label: Class settlement preliminary approval
keyDates.detail: Judge Timothy Boyer granted preliminary approval of the proposed $7.25 billion King v. Monsanto nationwide class settlement.

keyDates.label: Supreme Court decision in Monsanto v. Durnell
keyDates.detail: The Supreme Court held that FIFRA expressly preempted the state-law label-based failure-to-warn claim at issue in No. 24-1068.
